description: This file contains unit tests for the GstGenericPlayer component, including setup, teardown, and various configuration expectations using Google Test and Google Mock frameworks.

classes.name: GstGenericPlayerTestCommon
classes.description: A helper class providing setup, expectations, and trigger functions for testing GstGenericPlayer.

methods.name: gstPlayerWillBeCreated
methods.description: Sets up expectations for creating and initializing the GstGenericPlayer instance.

methods.name: gstPlayerWillBeDestroyed
methods.description: Sets up expectations for properly shutting down and cleaning up the GstGenericPlayer instance.

methods.name: expectShutdown
methods.description: Prepares expectations for the shutdown task and thread join.

methods.name: expectStop
methods.description: Prepares expectations for the stop task.

methods.name: executeTaskWhenEnqueued
methods.description: Mocks task execution when tasks are enqueued to the worker thread.

methods.name: triggerSetupSource
methods.description: Invokes the source setup callback with a given GstElement.

methods.name: triggerSetupElement
methods.description: Invokes the element setup callback with a given GstElement.

methods.name: triggerDeepElementAdded
methods.description: Invokes the deep element added callback with a given GstElement.

methods.name: setPipelineState
methods.description: Sets the pipeline state to the specified GstState.

methods.name: initFactories
methods.description: Initializes factory mocks for source and other components.

methods.name: expectMakePlaybin
methods.description: Sets expectation for creating the playbin element.

methods.name: expectSetFlags
methods.description: Sets expectations for configuring play flags.

methods.name: expectSetFlagsWithNativeAudio
methods.description: Sets expectations for configuring play flags with native audio support.

methods.name: expectSetSignalCallbacks
methods.description: Sets expectations for connecting GObject signals to callbacks.

methods.name: expectSetUri
methods.description: Sets expectation for setting the URI on the pipeline.

methods.name: expectCheckPlaySink
methods.description: Sets expectations for retrieving and configuring the play sink element.

methods.name: expectSetMessageCallback
methods.description: Sets expectation for creating the GStreamer dispatcher thread.
